meta_description: DK Electrix is your trusted electrician in Nottingham. NICEIC-approved domestic and commercial electrical work. Same-day callouts available.
hero_subhead: Faulty wiring, blown circuits, or a complete rewire? We're here fast, fix it right, and keep your home safe.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full installations, we handle domestic and commercial work to building regulations and NICEIC standards.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, flickering lights, dead sockets — we diagnose and fix the problem fast, often the same day. No surprise charges.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Older properties need new wiring for safety and insurance. We carry out complete rewires to Part P standards with a 10-year guarantee.

services.title: Consumer Unit & Fuse Board Upgrades
services.desc: Replace outdated fuse boards with modern RCD-protected consumer units. Safer electrics and better insurance cover.

services.title: Electric Heating & Underfloor Heating Installation
services.desc: Energy-efficient heating solutions for new builds or renovations. We install, test, and commission the full system.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Electrical Work
services.desc: Shop fit-outs, office rewires, and equipment installation. NICEIC approved and fully insured for business clients.

services.title: Testing, Inspection & Certification
services.desc: Annual electrical safety checks, landlord certifications, and pre-sale PAT testing. Keep your property compliant and insured.

about_pullquote: I fix electrics properly so families feel safe in their homes.
about_para_1: DK Electrix was founded on a simple promise: turn up on time, do the job right, and charge a fair price. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Nottingham for honest, skilled work — whether it's a leaking socket or a full house rewire. Every member of the team is NICEIC-approved and regularly trained on the latest safety standards.
about_para_2: We're based right here in Nottingham city centre, so we know our customers and our streets. Repeat business is our bread and butter — families and businesses call us back because they know we'll fix the problem, not just patch it over. We stand behind every job with guarantees and always give a clear quote upfront.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Customers Say About DK Electrix

reviews.text: Called them on a Sunday morning when our electrics went down completely. They answered straight away, came out within the hour, and had us back up and running by lunchtime. Really professional, explained everything as they went, and the price was fair. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Had them do a full rewire on our 1930s terrace. It was a big job but they were tidy, punctual, and didn't make a mess. They got the NICEIC certificate sorted quickly too. Very pleased and would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Patricia K.

reviews.text: Used DK Electrix for our shop fit-out last year and they were brilliant. Turned up when they said they would, quality of work was spot on, and they made sure everything passed inspection. Highly recommend them to any business owners.
reviews.author: David H.
